country.description: The country code for the manifest, used to determine the default paths for the various types of O3DE objects.

default.description: Default local paths for the various types of O3DE objects, these are the paths that will be used if the user does not specify a path.

engines_path.description: The default path for storing O3DE engines. i.e. 'C:/Users/colinb/O3DE/Engines' or '/home/colinb/O3DE/Engines/MyEngine'

projects_path.description: The default path for storing O3DE projects. i.e. 'C:/Users/colinb/O3DE/Projects' or '/home/colinb/O3DE/Projects'

gems_path.description: The default path for storing O3DE gems. i.e. 'C:/Users/colinb/O3DE/Gems' or '/home/colinb/O3DE/Gems'

templates_path.description: The default path for storing O3DE templates. i.e. 'C:/Users/colinb/O3DE/Templates' or '/home/colinb/O3DE/Templates'

overlays_path.description: The default path for storing O3DE overlays. i.e. 'C:/Users/colinb/O3DE/Overlays' or '/home/colinb/O3DE/Overlays'

repos_path.description: The default path for storing O3DE repos. i.e. 'C:/Users/colinb/O3DE/Repos' or '/home/colinb/O3DE/Repos'

third_party_path.description: The default path for storing third-party O3DE content. i.e. 'C:/Users/colinb/O3DE/3rdParty' or '/home/colinb/O3DE/3rdParty'
